errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that "Kombinierte Versorgung" has one of the largest shares in the outer ring. The largest share is "Übrige" (31.1%), followed by "Wasserversorgung" (11.8%). "Kombinierte Versorgung" is only 6.2%. This error is a result of the previously misread value of 11.9% for this category.
The description omits one category listed in the chart: there is no mention of the category "Kombinierte Versorgung" in the list of categories, even though its (incorrect) values are listed.
